name: geo
description: Geospatial in Rust: haversine distance, nearest neighbours (R-tree), bounding boxes.

capabilities.name: geo_distance
capabilities.description: Great-circle distance in meters between two WGS84 points (haversine).
capabilities.rules: lat in [-90, 90], lng in [-180, 180], decimal degrees.

capabilities.name: geo_nearest
capabilities.description: The nearest points to a location, closest first, with distances in meters. Builds an R-tree over the given points.
capabilities.rules: Send the candidate points in the request; limit caps the result (default 10).

capabilities.name: geo_bbox
capabilities.description: The bounding box of a set of points.
